Settings.TutorialDesc: A short walk through one real search
Settings.AboutDescription: XRPL Vanity {version} · CUDA and OpenCL search engines · fonts Inter and Cascadia Code, SIL Open Font License 1.1
Tutorial.OfferBody: You will run one real search and see what to do with the result. Nothing from it is kept. You can start it any time from Settings.
Tutorial.AddWordBody: Type a word of ten letters or more and press Enter.
Tutorial.ListFilesBody: Use “{save}” to write your words to a file. Use “{load}” to add them back later.
Tutorial.DevicesBody: Tick the CPU and any graphics cards, then press “{measure}”. The estimate needs that number.
Tutorial.LongWordBody: This is how long a match should take. If it looks quick, replace your word with one of ten letters or more.
Tutorial.ShortWordBody: Every extra character multiplies the wait by up to 58. Add a word of two or three letters.
Tutorial.SearchBody: Press “{start}”. The search stops at the first match. If it runs too long, stop it and shorten the word.
Tutorial.ResultBody: The seed controls this address, and whoever has it controls the account. Keep a real seed secret. This practice result disappears when the tutorial ends.
Tutorial.QrButtonBody: Press the QR button on the result.
Tutorial.QrDialogBody: With a real result, you would show this code and scan it with a wallet on your phone. You do not need to scan this one. Close the dialog to continue.
Tutorial.GpuDutyBody: A lower value leaves the card free for other applications.
Tutorial.StopAfterBody: A search runs until you press Stop. A number here ends it by itself.
Tutorial.NotificationsBody: A notification tells you about each match and when a search finishes.
Tutorial.DataFolderBody: Your results and settings are kept in this folder.
Tutorial.DoneBody: Finish puts your words and settings back as they were. You can start this tutorial again in Settings.
Tutorial.ShortestWordHint: An address needs only one of your words, so the shortest one sets the time. Remove the short words.
Tutorial.SearchRunning: A search is still running. Stop it, then try again.
Tutorial.LeaveMessage: Your words and settings come back as they were. You can start it again in Settings.
